2610.04036.title: MAGEFormer: Learning Metric-Consistent Representations for Anisotropic CT Segmentation
2610.04036.paper_summary: Vision Transformers (ViTs) have shown strong performance in volumetric segmentation, but their effectiveness on clinical CT is limited by an isotropic Euclidean lattice assumption. This conflicts with anisotropic CT acquisition, leading to two key issues: (1) a metric mismatch between voxel indices and physical anatomy, and (2) accuracy degradation from isotropic resampling. To address this, we propose MAGEFormer, a geometry-calibrated framework that embeds physical metric constraints directly into representation learning. Our method introduces Metric-Adaptive Spatial Embedding (MASE) to calibrate positional frequencies using voxel spacing, Geometry-Constrained Attention (GCA) to suppress physically implausible feature correlations, and Geometric View Voting (GVV) to reduce discretization bias during inference. We evaluate MAGEFormer on two multi-organ abdominal CT benchmarks, BTCV and FLARE 22, under a unified protocol against strong CNN and Transformer-based baselines. MAGEFormer achieves the strongest boundary accuracy among the compared methods, with 10.58 mm HD95 on BTCV and 3.40 mm HD95 on FLARE 22, and shows consistent gains in Dice under the same protocol. These results show that geometry-aware internal calibration is more effective than relying on conventional isotropic preprocessing alone for anisotropic CT segmentation.
2610.04036.paper_summary_zh: 視覺Transformer（ViTs）在體積分割中表現出色，但在臨床CT上的有效性受到各向同性歐幾里得晶格假設的限制。這與各向異性CT獲取相衝突，導致兩個主要問題：（1）體素索引與物理解剖之間的度量不匹配，以及（2）由於各向同性重採樣而導致的準確性下降。為了解決這個問題，我們提出了MAGEFormer，一個幾何校準框架，將物理度量約束直接嵌入到表示學習中。我們的方法引入了度量自適應空間嵌入（MASE），利用體素間距校準位置頻率，幾何約束注意力（GCA）以抑制物理上不合理的特徵相關性，以及幾何視圖投票（GVV）以減少推理過程中的離散化偏差。我們在兩個多器官腹部CT基準測試BTCV和FLARE 22上評估了MAGEFormer，並在統一協議下與強大的CNN和基於Transformer的基線進行比較。MAGEFormer在比較的方法中達到了最強的邊界準確性，在BTCV上為10.58 mm HD95，在FLARE 22上為3.40 mm HD95，並在相同協議下顯示出Dice的一致增益。這些結果表明，幾何感知的內部校準比僅依賴傳統的各向同性預處理對於各向異性CT分割更有效。
